title: Germany: Low Crime, Clean Prisons, Lessons for America | Jeff Rosen | TEDxMountainViewHighSchool
summary: Santa Clara County District Attorney Jeff Rosen explains in a TEDx talk why Germany has lower crime and far fewer prisoners than the US, and what American criminal justice could learn from German prisons.
why: HN recommends it as a comparison of German rehabilitative prisons with American retributive justice, backed by statistics.

quote.text: the whole talk is rather worthwhile to watch
